column2:
bald(adj.)禿頭的、光禿的
baldness(n.)禿頭
go bald 禿頭
bald spot 禿的地方
My uncle started to go bald in his thirties.
(我叔叔三十多歲就開始禿頭。)
The bald eagle is the national bird of the United States.
(白頭海鵰是美國的國鳥。)

ballet(n.)芭蕾舞
ballerina(n.)芭蕾舞女伶
ballet dancer 芭蕾舞者
ballet class 芭蕾舞課
She has taken ballet classes since she was five.
(她從五歲起就開始上芭蕾舞課。)
We watched a ballet performance at the National Theater.
(我們在國家戲劇院觀賞了一場芭蕾舞演出。)

bandage(n./v.)繃帶、用繃帶包紮
(無詞性變化)
apply a bandage 包上繃帶
bandage a wound 包紮傷口
The nurse wrapped a bandage around my injured ankle.
(護理師在我受傷的腳踝上纏了繃帶。)
He quickly bandaged the cut on his friend's arm.
(他迅速包紮了朋友手臂上的傷口。)

bankrupt(adj./v./n.)破產的、使破產、破產者
bankruptcy(n.)破產
go bankrupt 破產
declare bankruptcy 宣告破產
The company went bankrupt after years of losses.
(那家公司虧損多年後破產了。)
Bad investments nearly bankrupted the family.
(錯誤的投資幾乎讓這個家庭破產。)

bargain(n./v.)便宜貨、協議、討價還價
(無詞性變化)
a real bargain 真划算的東西
bargain with 與…討價還價
At this price, the jacket is a real bargain.
(以這個價格來說，這件夾克真的很划算。)
Tourists often bargain with vendors at night markets.
(觀光客常在夜市和攤販討價還價。)

barrier(n.)障礙、柵欄、隔閡
(無詞性變化)
language barrier 語言隔閡
break down barriers 打破障礙
The language barrier made it hard for him to make friends abroad.
(語言隔閡讓他在國外很難交到朋友。)
Police put up barriers to keep the crowd back.
(警方架起柵欄擋住人群。)

basin(n.)臉盆、盆地、流域
(無詞性變化)
wash basin 洗臉盆
Taipei Basin 台北盆地
Taipei is located in a basin surrounded by mountains.
(台北位在一個群山環繞的盆地中。)
She filled the basin with warm water.
(她把臉盆裝滿溫水。)

battery(n.)電池
(無詞性變化)
battery life 電池續航力
charge the battery 充電
My phone's battery dies quickly when I play games.
(我玩遊戲時手機電池很快就沒電。)
Remember to charge the battery before the trip.
(旅行前記得把電池充飽。)

beggar(n.)乞丐
beg(v.)乞討、懇求
street beggar 街頭乞丐
beggars can't be choosers 乞丐沒有挑選的權利
A beggar sat outside the station asking for money.
(一名乞丐坐在車站外乞討。)
Beggars can't be choosers, so I took the last seat.
(沒得挑剔，所以我坐了最後一個位子。)

behavior(n.)行為、舉止
behave(v.)表現、守規矩
behavioral(adj.)行為的
good behavior 良好行為
human behavior 人類行為
The teacher praised the students for their good behavior.
(老師稱讚學生們的良好表現。)
Scientists study animal behavior in the wild.
(科學家研究野生動物的行為。)

bin(n.)箱子、垃圾桶
(無詞性變化)
recycling bin 資源回收桶
trash bin 垃圾桶
Please put empty bottles in the recycling bin.
(請把空瓶放進資源回收桶。)
He threw the old letters into the trash bin.
(他把舊信丟進垃圾桶。)

biography(n.)傳記
biographer(n.)傳記作者
biographical(adj.)傳記的
autobiography 自傳
write a biography 撰寫傳記
I am reading a biography of Steve Jobs.
(我正在讀賈伯斯的傳記。)
Her biography describes her difficult childhood.
(她的傳記描述了她艱困的童年。)

biology(n.)生物學
biologist(n.)生物學家
biological(adj.)生物的
marine biology 海洋生物學
biology class 生物課
She wants to study marine biology in college.
(她想在大學念海洋生物學。)
We learned about cells in biology class.
(我們在生物課學到細胞。)

blade(n.)刀刃、刀片、葉片
(無詞性變化)
razor blade 刮鬍刀片
blade of grass 草葉
Be careful—the blade of this knife is very sharp.
(小心，這把刀的刀刃非常鋒利。)
Dew covered every blade of grass in the morning.
(早晨露水覆蓋著每一片草葉。)

blend(v./n.)混合、融合、混合物
blender(n.)果汁機
blend in 融入
a blend of 混合…
Blend the bananas and milk until smooth.
(把香蕉和牛奶攪拌到滑順。)
The new student tried hard to blend in with his classmates.
(那位新同學努力融入同學之中。)

blessing(n.)祝福、幸事
bless(v.)祝福、保佑
a blessing in disguise 因禍得福
count one's blessings 知足惜福
Missing the bus turned out to be a blessing in disguise.
(沒搭上公車結果反而因禍得福。)
My parents gave their blessing to my plan to study abroad.
(我父母祝福我出國念書的計畫。)

blink(v./n.)眨眼、閃爍
(無詞性變化)
in the blink of an eye 一眨眼間
blink back tears 眨眼忍住淚水
The summer vacation was over in the blink of an eye.
(暑假一眨眼就結束了。)
The lights on the tree blinked all night.
(樹上的燈整晚閃爍著。)

bloom(n./v.)花、開花、繁盛
(無詞性變化)
in full bloom 盛開
come into bloom 開始開花
The cherry blossoms are in full bloom on Yangmingshan.
(陽明山上的櫻花正盛開。)
These flowers only bloom in spring.
(這些花只在春天開花。)

blossom(n./v.)(果樹的)花、開花、發展
(無詞性變化)
cherry blossoms 櫻花
blossom into 發展成
Many people go hiking to see the cherry blossoms.
(許多人去健行賞櫻花。)
Their friendship blossomed into love.
(他們的友誼發展成了愛情。)

boast(v./n.)自誇、以擁有…自豪、誇耀
boastful(adj.)自誇的
boast about 吹噓…
proud boast 引以為傲的事
He likes to boast about his test scores.
(他喜歡吹噓自己的考試成績。)
The city boasts the tallest building in the country.
(這座城市擁有全國最高的建築。)

bond(n./v.)聯繫、羈絆、債券、結合
bonding(n.)建立感情
strong bond 緊密的連結
bond with 與…建立感情
There is a strong bond between the two sisters.
(那兩姊妹之間的感情很深厚。)
Playing sports helps teammates bond with each other.
(一起運動有助於隊友建立感情。)

bounce(v./n.)彈跳、反彈
bouncy(adj.)有彈性的
bounce back 恢復、反彈
bounce a ball 拍球
The ball bounced off the wall and hit the window.
(球從牆上彈開打到窗戶。)
She bounced back quickly after losing the game.
(輸了比賽後她很快就振作起來。)

bracelet(n.)手鐲、手鍊
(無詞性變化)
gold bracelet 金手鐲
wear a bracelet 戴手鍊
She wore a silver bracelet her grandmother gave her.
(她戴著祖母送她的銀手鍊。)
I made a bracelet for my best friend's birthday.
(我做了一條手鍊送給好朋友當生日禮物。)

breed(n./v.)品種、繁殖、飼養
breeder(n.)飼養者
breeding(n.)繁殖、教養
breed of dog 狗的品種
breed animals 飼養動物
The golden retriever is a popular breed of dog.
(黃金獵犬是很受歡迎的狗品種。)
Mosquitoes breed in standing water.
(蚊子在積水中繁殖。)

bridegroom(n.)新郎
groom(n./v.)新郎(口語)、馬夫、打扮
bride and groom 新郎新娘
handsome bridegroom 英俊的新郎
The bridegroom looked nervous before the wedding.
(新郎在婚禮前看起來很緊張。)
Guests threw flower petals at the bride and groom.
(賓客向新郎新娘撒花瓣。)

broke(adj.)身無分文的、破產的
(無詞性變化)
flat broke 一文不名
go broke 破產
I'm broke until I get paid next week.
(我在下週領薪水前都身無分文。)
Many small shops went broke during the pandemic.
(許多小商店在疫情期間倒閉了。)

broom(n.)掃帚
(無詞性變化)
sweep with a broom 用掃帚掃
broom closet 掃具櫃
He swept the classroom floor with a broom.
(他用掃帚掃教室的地板。)
In the story, the witch flew on a broom.
(故事裡，女巫騎著掃帚飛行。)

brutal(adj.)殘忍的、嚴酷的、直率的
brutality(n.)殘暴
brutally(adv.)殘忍地、毫不留情地
brutal attack 殘暴的攻擊
brutal honesty 毫不留情的坦白
The brutal heat made it hard to play outside.
(酷熱讓人很難在戶外玩耍。)
The movie shows the brutal reality of war.
(這部電影呈現出戰爭殘酷的現實。)

bulletin(n.)公告、公報、快報
(無詞性變化)
bulletin board 布告欄
news bulletin 新聞快報
The exam schedule is posted on the bulletin board.
(考試時程貼在布告欄上。)
The TV show was interrupted by a news bulletin.
(電視節目被一則新聞快報打斷。)

burglar(n.)竊賊、闖空門者
burglary(n.)入室竊盜
burglar alarm 防盜警報器
catch a burglar 抓到竊賊
A burglar broke into the house while the family was away.
(這家人不在時，一名竊賊闖入屋內。)
The burglar alarm went off in the middle of the night.
(防盜警報器在半夜響起。)
